results.name: Money Heist
results.overview: To carry out the biggest heist in history, a mysterious man called The Professor recruits a band of eight robbers who have a single characteristic: none of them has anything to lose. Five months of seclusion - memorizing every step, every detail, every probability - culminate in eleven days locked up in the National Coinage and Stamp Factory of Spain, surrounded by police forces and with dozens of hostages in their power, to find out whether their suicide wager will lead to everything or nothing.

results.title: Casa Roshell
results.overview: Casa Roshell is a space in Mexico founded by the trans activist Roshell Terranova. A small, intimate room with a stage sets the scene for performances, workshops, and lip-syncs. For its members, Casa Roshell is somewhere where they can assume an alternative gender role and explore their identity.

results.name: Casa di Beau
results.overview: Beau van Erven Dorens welcomes a series of special guests to the enchanting Lake Maggiore in Italy. In addition to engaging interviews, this year’s program is packed with shared activities such as exercising, cooking, boating, or simply relaxing by the pool. It is precisely these informal moments that often result in unexpected and entertaining television.

results.title: Casa chica
results.overview: While their mother unpacks removal boxes, Valentina (5) and Quique (11) run riot around the flat. Their parents have separated. When their father picks them up to show them his new, old life, the children receive a painful glimpse into the adult world.

results.name: La casa nostra
results.overview: Miqui shares an apartment with his best friend, Èric, and leads a more or less stable life until, in the span of just a few days, two unexpected events force him to rethink his entire future. Left with few alternatives, he ends up moving back into the family home, where he must live with his parents again while trying to rebuild his personal and professional life. Surrounding him are neighbors, friends, and family members who turn every minor daily issue into an endless source of complications, misunderstandings, and situations that are absurdly relatable.

results.name: Casa de muñecos
